newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Austrim buys plant hire group for A$41 mln.
newsitem.headline: Austrim buys plant hire group for A$41 mln.

text.p: Investment group Austrim Ltd said on Wednesday it had entered into agreements to acquire the plant and vehicle hire and workshop business from the South Australian Commissioner of Highways for about A$41 million.

Austrim said the acquisition would be made through its unit All Hire Pty Ltd. It said All Hire has also entered into five year agreements to hire a substantial proportion of the acquired assets to the South Australian government.
The company is led by former BTR Plc chief executive Alan Jackson. Austrim acquired a textile firm last month for A$53 million.
